remarks: Discover the charm of 'The Mews' at 35 Fairfield Ave, Norwalk, CT. Immerse yourself in modern living within this completely updated 1BR haven, embodying today's top home styles and trends. The first-floor unit boasts a brand-new kitchen adorned with white marbled quartz countertops, sleek white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a stylish subway tile backsplash. Step into spacious elegance as the large bedroom and oversized living room showcase wide plank luxury vinyl flooring. The bathroom is a sanctuary of luxury, featuring a white sink cabinet, marbled quartz countertop, faucet, medicine cabinet, subway tiles, floor tiles, floor heater, tub shower head, and a new door. Nestled in the Golden Hill Historic District, this residence offers the convenience of walking distance to the new SONO mall and SONO center. In just minutes, explore the library, post office, exceptional restaurants, shopping destinations, cinema, and the train station. Welcome to a contemporary lifestyle in the heart of Norwalk
